_comment: Native LinkedIn discovery is the supported path for this project. Enable it via `sources.linkedin_browser.enabled: true` in `config/local.yaml` (see `crates/careerai-core/src/templates/default.yaml` for the full schema). The native path is config-driven, daemon-integrated, governor-rate-limited, and reuses the M5 stealth-v2.js + `li_at` cookie infrastructure. The two LinkedIn community MCPs below are kept disabled by default as alternative discovery surfaces for power users; flip `disabled: false` per server at your own ToS risk.

careerai.comment: Local careerai-mcp server. Install: `cargo install --git https://github.com/justdoGIT/career-ai careerai-mcp` (or grab a prebuilt binary from the GitHub Releases page once tagged). The plugin's slash commands and skills route most calls through this server.

linkedin-jobs.comment: RapidAPI-backed LinkedIn discovery (ToS-clean, no scraping; free tier exists). Disabled by default for two reasons: (1) the upstream `Rom7699/linkedin-jobs-mcp-server` ships as `python main.py` with no `[project.scripts]` entry, so this `uvx` invocation will fail until upstream is packaged; (2) the supported discovery path for this project is the native `linkedin_browser` source (config-driven, daemon-integrated, see `sources.linkedin_browser` in `crates/careerai-core/src/templates/default.yaml`). To opt in to the native path, edit `config/local.yaml` and flip `sources.linkedin_browser.enabled: true` — no MCP needed.

linkedin-browser.comment: Community browser-based LinkedIn scraper (`adhikasp/mcp-linkedin`). Disabled because this project ships its own native `linkedin_browser` source that drives the same kind of stealth Chromium session, integrates with the daemon's cron, honors per-source rate caps via `governor`, and reuses the `li_at` cookie + stealth-v2.js infrastructure already audited in M5. Prefer enabling `sources.linkedin_browser.enabled: true` in `config/local.yaml` over flipping this MCP. Both paths violate LinkedIn User Agreement §8.2; the native path is just easier to operate.
